# BusinesDoctor
> Engineering Technology. Accelerating Digital Growth.

BusinesDoctor is an enterprise digital services practice delivering full-stack software development, performance digital marketing, UI/UX architecture, e-commerce marketplace scaling, creative video production, and cloud IT infrastructure.

Website: https://demo.businesdoctor.com/

This index links to Markdown resources intended for AI/LLM consumption. All listed URLs must be verified canonical pages reflecting published website content.

## Core Practice Disciplines
- [SMO — Social Media Optimization](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/smo): Strategic profile optimization, bio conversion funnels, branded content templates, and improved social visibility.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/google-business-profile): Complete GBP setup, Google Maps optimization, local search visibility, profile management, and review strategy.
- [PPC / Paid Ads](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/ppc-paid-ads): High-converting Google Search, Performance Max, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn B2B advertising campaigns.
- [Ecommerce Management](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/ecommerce-management): Amazon and Flipkart marketplace management, product listings, inventory optimization, A+ content, and marketplace growth.
- [Graphic Design](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/graphic-design): Corporate brand identity, creative graphics, marketing materials, social media creatives, and visual communication.
- [SEO — Search Engine Optimization](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/seo): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, keyword strategy, search visibility, organic traffic, and performance monitoring.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/social-media-marketing): Social media strategy, content planning, campaign management, audience engagement, and brand growth.
- [Product Photography](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/product-photography): Professional product photography, ecommerce product visuals, creative compositions, and conversion-focused imagery.
- [Video Editing](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/video-editing): Professional promotional videos, short-form content, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and brand videos.
- [Web Development](https://demo.businesdoctor.com/service/web-development): Fast, responsive business websites, custom web applications, performance optimization, and conversion-focused development.
